questions.explanation: 前文提到她作为体操运动员参加奥运会的希望破灭，后文提到她在射击中找到了荣耀的道路，因此这是一条对她而言“全新”的道路。选C。
questions.supplement:
A(smooth)：语境句：We hope you have a smooth flight. 固定搭配：smooth away, go smoothly
B(narrow)：语境句：The streets in the old town are very narrow. 固定搭配：narrow down, narrow escape
C(new)：语境句：She is adapting to her new environment. 固定搭配：brand new, new generation
D(traditional)：语境句：They celebrated the festival in a traditional way. 固定搭配：traditional culture, traditional values

questions.explanation: 此处为现在分词作伴随状语。她在射击中找到新道路，在周三“赢得”了危地马拉历史上的首枚金牌。
questions.supplement:
A(winning)：语境句：He succeeded in winning the championship. 固定搭配：win a prize, win over
B(expecting)：语境句：We are expecting a lot of guests this weekend. 固定搭配：expect much of, highly expected
C(seeing)：语境句：Seeing is believing. 固定搭配：see off, see to it that
D(telling)：语境句：There is no telling what will happen next. 固定搭配：tell apart, tell a lie

questions.explanation: 根据语境，在体育馆里她正在“准备”2011年世锦赛，这被描述为伦敦奥运会的决定性资格赛。prepare for意为“为……做准备”。
questions.supplement:
A(waiting for)：语境句：I have been waiting for the bus for an hour. 固定搭配：wait for, keep sb waiting
B(preparing for)：语境句：Students are busy preparing for the final exams. 固定搭配：prepare for, be well prepared
C(talking about)：语境句：What are you guys talking about? 固定搭配：talk about, talk over
D(worrying about)：语境句：There is no need worrying about his safety. 固定搭配：worry about, be worried about

questions.explanation: 第一段指出她原本的希望是成为一名体操运动员(gymnast)，因此她当时准备的世锦赛自然是“体操(gymnastics)”比赛。
questions.supplement:
A(shooting)：语境句：Shooting requires a lot of concentration. 固定搭配：shooting star, shooting range
B(gymnastics)：语境句：She has been practicing gymnastics since childhood. 固定搭配：artistic gymnastics, rhythmic gymnastics
C(swimming)：语境句：Swimming is an excellent way to keep fit. 固定搭配：swimming pool, go swimming
D(tennis)：语境句：He plays tennis every Sunday morning. 固定搭配：play tennis, tennis court

questions.explanation: 句意为“扫描检查‘显示(showed)’有六处受损的椎骨”。produce产生；cure治愈；break打破，均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(produced)：语境句：The factory produced a large number of cars. 固定搭配：mass-produced, produce a result
B(cured)：语境句：The doctor successfully cured him of his illness. 固定搭配：cure sb of sth, a cure for
C(broke)：语境句：He broke the world record in the 100-meter dash. 固定搭配：break down, break out
D(showed)：语境句：The latest data showed a significant increase in sales. 固定搭配：show off, show up

questions.explanation: 脊柱损伤使得她无法继续练体操，因此这结束了她年仅16岁的体操“生涯(career)”。
questions.supplement:
A(career)：语境句：He decided to pursue a career in medicine. 固定搭配：career path, academic career
B(class)：语境句：I have a math class this afternoon. 固定搭配：first-class, take a class
C(application)：语境句：Her application for the job was rejected. 固定搭配：fill out an application, practical application
D(call)：语境句：I missed a call from my mother. 固定搭配：make a call, call off

questions.explanation: 后文提到她戴着背部支撑护具，说明她花了一年时间来“康复(recovering)”。
questions.supplement:
A(training)：语境句：He is undergoing strict physical training. 固定搭配：training session, vocational training
B(thinking)：语境句：I was just thinking about you. 固定搭配：forward-thinking, critical thinking
C(recovering)：语境句：He is slowly recovering from a severe heart attack. 固定搭配：recover from, fully recover
D(writing)：语境句：She enjoys writing in her spare time. 固定搭配：in writing, writing skills

questions.explanation: 医生建议她如果不想让伤势恶化又想继续参与“体育运动(sports)”，可以尝试射击。射击和体操都属于sports大类。
questions.supplement:
A(literature)：语境句：She majored in English literature at university. 固定搭配：classical literature, modern literature
B(medicine)：语境句：Laughter is the best medicine. 固定搭配：take medicine, traditional Chinese medicine
C(arts)：语境句：He has a great talent for the fine arts. 固定搭配：liberal arts, martial arts
D(sports)：语境句：Doing sports regularly is beneficial to our health. 固定搭配：sports meet, extreme sports

questions.explanation: 前句提到受伤后她一无所有，因此结合并列连词and后的discouraged(气馁的)，可知她开始变得“绝望(desperate)”。
questions.supplement:
A(desperate)：语境句：They made a desperate attempt to save the drowning child. 固定搭配：be desperate for, in desperate need
B(nervous)：语境句：She felt nervous before the job interview. 固定搭配：nervous system, get nervous
C(happy)：语境句：Money cannot always buy a happy life. 固定搭配：happy ending, more than happy to
D(curious)：语境句：Children are naturally curious about the world around them. 固定搭配：be curious about, out of curiosity

questions.explanation: 根据文章脉络，她从练体操变成了练射击，此处表达从体操到射击的“转变”，change from A to B 意为“从A转变为B”。
questions.supplement:
A(teaching)：语境句：Teaching is a respected profession. 固定搭配：teaching method, teaching assistant
B(changing)：语境句：The world is changing at a rapid pace. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change into
C(copying)：语境句：Stop copying my homework! 固定搭配：copy down, carbon copy
D(failing)：语境句：He is failing in math this semester. 固定搭配：without fail, fail to do

questions.explanation: 句意为Ruano伴随着深呼吸和精准的一击命中了第43个目标，“取得(achieved)”了胜利。celebrated意为庆祝，通常在胜利之后，而此处正在命中目标锁定胜局。
questions.supplement:
A(lost)：语境句：He lost his way in the dense forest. 固定搭配：be lost in, get lost
B(imagined)：语境句：I never imagined we would meet here. 固定搭配：beyond imagine, imagine doing sth
C(achieved)：语境句：Through hard work, she achieved her goals. 固定搭配：achieve success, achieve a balance
D(celebrated)：语境句：We celebrated his birthday with a big cake. 固定搭配：celebrate a victory, widely celebrated

questions.explanation: 她命中目标需要的是“精确的(exact)”一击。long长的；possible可能的；close接近的，都不足以强调命中的准确性。
questions.supplement:
A(long)：语境句：We have a long way to go before we reach our destination. 固定搭配：in the long run, as long as
B(exact)：语境句：What were his exact words? 固定搭配：to be exact, exact match
C(possible)：语境句：Is it possible for you to help me with this? 固定搭配：as soon as possible, make it possible
D(close)：语境句：The hospital is very close to my house. 固定搭配：close friend, pay close attention to

questions.explanation: Ruano为危地马拉“创造”了历史。make history 为固定搭配，意为“创造历史”。
questions.supplement:
A(illustrates)：语境句：This example illustrates my point perfectly. 固定搭配：illustrate a point, vividly illustrate
B(studies)：语境句：Recent studies show that diet affects mental health. 固定搭配：further studies, case study
C(records)：语境句：He set two new world records. 固定搭配：break a record, keep a record
D(makes)：语境句：She makes a living by selling flowers. 固定搭配：make history, make a difference

questions.explanation: 她从一名因伤退役的体操选手，转项射击并最终夺得奥运金牌，这段旅程无疑是“令人难以置信的(incredible)”。
questions.supplement:
A(incredible)：语境句：The view from the top of the mountain is incredible. 固定搭配：incredible journey, incredible speed
B(pleasant)：语境句：We spent a pleasant afternoon walking in the park. 固定搭配：pleasant surprise, pleasant environment
C(fruitless)：语境句：Their efforts to find a cure proved fruitless. 固定搭配：fruitless search, fruitless attempt
D(predictable)：语境句：The plot of the movie was completely predictable. 固定搭配：highly predictable, predictable outcome

questions.explanation: 根据下文最后一句“Ruano's journey back to elite sports began with a volunteer activity...”，可知她有作为“志愿者(volunteer)”的开阔眼界的经历。
questions.supplement:
A(doctor)：语境句：You'd better see a doctor about that cough. 固定搭配：family doctor, medical doctor
B(coach)：语境句：The coach instructed the players to defend aggressively. 固定搭配：head coach, football coach
C(medalist)：语境句：He is a gold medalist in the long jump. 固定搭配：Olympic medalist, silver medalist
D(volunteer)：语境句：She works as a volunteer at the local hospital. 固定搭配：volunteer work, volunteer to do sth

vocab_pack.definition_en: to destroy someone's expectations or dreams
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中用过去式 dashed，表示已发生的动作，搭配 hope 的复数形式 hopes。
vocab_pack.example_en: The accident dashed her hopes of becoming a dancer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那场事故使她成为舞者的希望破灭了。

vocab_pack.definition_en: never done or achieved before; the first of its kind
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词作定语，修饰 gold medal，表示有史以来第一枚金牌。
vocab_pack.example_en: This is the first-ever performance of the new symphony.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这是新交响曲的首次演出。

vocab_pack.definition_en: having a critical or determining effect on the outcome
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰 qualifier，表示该资格赛对能否参加奥运会起决定作用。
vocab_pack.example_en: The final match was a decisive victory for the team.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 决赛是那支球队的决定性胜利。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to suffer from intense pain in the back
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词形式作 began 的宾语，表示开始经历背痛。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many office workers experience severe back pain from sitting all day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多上班族因整天坐着而经历严重的背痛。

vocab_pack.definition_en: harmed or injured physically
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词作定语，修饰 vertebrae，表示「受损的椎骨」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The damaged car could not be repaired.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那辆受损的车无法修理。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to bring someone's professional life to a close
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 ended，表示伤害使她的体操生涯终止。
vocab_pack.example_en: A serious injury ended his football career at age 20.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一次重伤在他20岁时结束了他的足球生涯。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use a period of time doing a particular activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 spent，后接表示时间段的宾语 a year，然后接动名词 recovering。
vocab_pack.example_en: She spent two months preparing for the exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她花了两个月准备考试。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a brace or support device on the back
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作伴随状语，说明恢复期间的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: The doctor advised him to wear a back support while lifting heavy objects.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 医生建议他提起重物时佩戴背部支撑。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue participating or being active in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: stay 为系动词，后接过去分词 involved 作表语，再接介词 in 引出领域。
vocab_pack.example_en: He wants to stay involved in the community after retirement.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他退休后想继续参与社区活动。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make a physical injury more severe
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词形式作介词 without 的宾语，表示「在没有加重伤势的情况下」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He continued running, worsening his knee injury.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他继续跑步，加重了膝盖的伤势。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become extremely anxious or hopeless
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 变得绝望；感到走投无路
vocab_pack.grammar_note: get + 形容词，表示状态的转变；原句为 start to get desperate，开始变得绝望。
vocab_pack.example_en: After months of job hunting, she began to get desperate.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 找了几个月工作后，她开始变得绝望。

vocab_pack.definition_en: having lost confidence or enthusiasm; disheartened
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，与 desperate 并列，描述她的情绪状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: Don't be discouraged by one failure; keep trying.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不要因一次失败就灰心，继续努力。

vocab_pack.definition_en: an opportunity becomes available to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 比喻用法，动词 opened 为过去时，表示机会出现了。
vocab_pack.example_en: After graduating, many doors opened for her in the tech industry.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 毕业后，科技行业的许多机会之门向她敞开。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to switch from one activity or situation to another
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词短语作介词 after 的宾语，表示「从体操转为射击之后」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She changed from a full-time job to freelancing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她从全职工作转为自由职业。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to result in success; to be worthwhile
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 paid off，表示她的坚持最终取得了成功。
vocab_pack.example_en: All the hard work paid off when she won the scholarship.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她赢得奖学金时，所有的努力都得到了回报。

vocab_pack.definition_en: achieving the best result ever in Olympic competition
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 奥运纪录的；创奥运纪录的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词修饰 score，表示该得分打破了奥运会纪录。
vocab_pack.example_en: She set an Olympic-record time in the 100-meter dash.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在100米短跑中创下了奥运纪录。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to win or gain a victory
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 achieved，后接 her victory 作宾语，表示赢得了胜利。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team achieved a historic victory in the championship.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那支队伍在锦标赛中取得了历史性的胜利。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a long, full intake of air
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作介词 with 的宾语，与 an exact shot 并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: Take a deep breath before you speak in public.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在公开演讲前先做个深呼吸。

vocab_pack.definition_en: precise and accurate
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰 shot，表示一次精确的射击。
vocab_pack.example_en: The archer made an exact hit on the bullseye.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那位弓箭手精确命中靶心。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to do better than; to exceed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原形动词，用在情态动词 couldn't 之后，表示无法超越她。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her score surpassed all previous records.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的分数超越了所有之前的纪录。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to do something important that will be recorded in history
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，第三人称单数 makes，主语 Adriana Ruano。
vocab_pack.example_en: The young athlete made history by winning two gold medals.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位年轻运动员赢得两枚金牌，创造了历史。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who has won a gold medal
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，前由 first 修饰，作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She became an Olympic gold medalist at the age of 19.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在19岁时成为奥运金牌得主。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a woman who has won a medal in competition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，first 修饰，表示该国首位女性奖牌得主。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is the first female medalist from her country in this sport.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她是该国在这个项目上的首位女性奖牌得主。

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely good or amazing; hard to believe
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰代词 one（指代 journey），作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The view from the mountain was incredible.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 从山上看去的景色令人难以置信。

vocab_pack.definition_en: entirely not the same; totally distinct
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词 completely 修饰形容词 different，一起修饰 sport。
vocab_pack.example_en: His teaching style is completely different from mine.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的教学风格与我的完全不同。

vocab_pack.definition_en: causing surprise or providing new understanding
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词修饰 experience，表示这次经历让人眼界大开。
vocab_pack.example_en: Traveling abroad was an eye-opening experience for the students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 出国旅行对学生来说是一次大开眼界的经历。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who freely offers to do something without payment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作介词 as 的宾语，表示以志愿者身份参与。
vocab_pack.example_en: She worked as a volunteer at the local hospital.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在当地医院做志愿者。

vocab_pack.definition_en: an unpaid activity done for a cause or community
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，前由 a 限定，作介词 with 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many students participate in volunteer activities during summer break.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多学生在暑假参加志愿者活动。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the Olympic Games, an international multi-sport event
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 专有名词，常以复数形式出现，前有定冠词 the（原文中为 the 2016 Olympics）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Olympics are held every four years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 奥林匹克运动会每四年举办一次。

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: found a new path to glory
vocab_pack.definition_en: to discover a route to success or fame
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式 found，a new path to glory 为宾语，表示找到了新的成功之路。
vocab_pack.example_en: After many failures, he finally found a path to glory through music.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 多次失败后，他终于通过音乐找到了通往荣耀的道路。
vocab_pack.from_passage: found a new path to glory

section_2_word_form.passage:
The traditional Chinese folk art of New Year painting, known [56] Nianhua in Chinese, dates back to the Western Han Dynasty and it developed into a formal art form during the Northern Song Dynasty (960 - 1127), when it was customary [57] colorful artworks depicting gods and use these to decorate doors during the Chinese Lunisolar New Year — to ward off bad spirits.
The primary technique [58] in New Year painting is woodblock printing. The process [59] printing the basic outlines of the design in black ink. This is done using a woodblock [60] has been carved to represent the drawing's lines. Once this base layer (层) is printed, [61] woodblocks are used for each color in the final painting. These color blocks are carefully carved and must perfectly align with the black outlines.
After the main colors are printed onto the same sheet of paper and after [62] these specific blocks, some parts may have to be colored by hand. This is [63] done to improve small details and lift the painting's visual impact.
One of the most famous [64] in the genre is the woodblock New Year painting from Zhuxian Town in Kaifeng, central China's Henan Province.
This design features bold and concise lines. It originated and flourished in Kaifeng, then [65] capital of the Northern Song Dynasty and located about 20km from Zhuxian Town.

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配。be known as 意为“作为……而闻名/被称为……”，此处用过去分词短语 known as 作后置定语，修饰 The traditional Chinese folk art of New Year painting。
questions.supplement: 正确形(as)：语境句：He is known as a brilliant scientist. 固定搭配：be known as, act as。所给词None，无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。句型 it is customary to do sth 意为“做某事是习俗”，其中 it 为形式主语，真正的主语是不定式 to create...。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to create)：语境句：It takes a lot of imagination to create a good story. 固定搭配：create opportunities, create an atmosphere。原词create其它变形：creation (n.), creative (adj.), creator (n.)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。technique 与 use 之间为动宾(被动)关系，故用过去分词 used 作后置定语，意为“年画中使用的主要技术”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(used)：语境句：The methods used in this research are very advanced. 固定搭配：get used to, be used for。原词use其它变形：useful (adj.), useless (adj.), usage (n.)。

questions.explanation: 考查动词时态与主谓一致。该句描述客观事实或普遍规律，应使用一般现在时；主语 The process 为单数，谓语动词需用单数第三人称形式 involves。
questions.supplement: 正确形(involves)：语境句：The new project involves a lot of teamwork. 固定搭配：involve doing sth, be involved in。原词involve其它变形：involved (adj.), involvement (n.)。

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。先行词是 a woodblock(指物)，在后面的限制性定语从句中作主语，故使用关系代词 that 或 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that/which)：语境句：The book that/which you lent me is extremely fascinating. 固定搭配：in which, of which。所给词None，无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。此处修饰名词 woodblocks(木板)，需要使用形容词形式，表示“额外的”，故填 additional。
questions.supplement: 正确形(additional)：语境句：We need additional information to solve this case. 固定搭配：additional cost, additional support。原词addition其它变形：add (v.), additionally (adv.)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。介词 after 之后接动词时，需使用动名词(V-ing)形式，故填 adopting。
questions.supplement: 正确形(adopting)：语境句：After adopting the new policy, the company saw a rise in profits. 固定搭配：adopt a method, adopt an orphan。原词adopt其它变形：adoption (n.), adopted (adj.)。

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。此处需用副词修饰谓语动词的被动形式 is done，表示“通常地/典型地”，故填 typically。
questions.supplement: 正确形(typically)：语境句：This type of problem is typically solved by using a formula. 固定搭配：typically speaking。原词typical其它变形：type (n.), typically (adv.)。

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。固定句型 one of the + 形容词最高级 + 可数名词复数，意为“最……的……之一”，故填 styles。
questions.supplement: 正确形(styles)：语境句：The museum displays artworks from various historical styles. 固定搭配：in style, out of style。原词style其它变形：stylish (adj.), stylist (n.)。

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。此处特指北宋当时的首都（开封），capital 前需要加定冠词 the，then the capital 意为“当时的首都”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(the)：语境句：Beijing is the capital of China. 固定搭配：the former, the latter。所给词None，无其它变形。

vocab_pack.definition_en: traditional art created by people in a community, often handcrafted
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作主语的一部分，描述传统中国民间艺术。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many tourists are attracted to the local folk art displayed in the village.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多游客被村庄里展示的当地民间艺术所吸引。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The traditional Chinese folk art of New Year painting, known as Nianhua in Chinese

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have existed since a particular time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语单数 art，谓语用 dates back，表示该艺术形式起源于西汉时期。
vocab_pack.example_en: These ancient ruins date back to the Roman Empire.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些古代遗址可以追溯到罗马帝国时期。
vocab_pack.from_passage: dates back to the Western Han Dynasty

vocab_pack.definition_en: to change gradually into a more advanced or larger form
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，描述该艺术形式在北宋代发展成为正式的艺术形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The small company developed into a multinational corporation over twenty years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家小公司在二十年内发展成了一家跨国公司。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it developed into a formal art form during the Northern Song Dynasty

vocab_pack.definition_en: it is a common tradition or habit to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形式主语 it + be 动词过去时 was + 形容词 customary + 不定式 to do，表示过去的一种惯例。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is customary to bow when greeting someone in Japan.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在日本，打招呼时鞠躬是一种惯例。
vocab_pack.from_passage: when it was customary to create colorful artworks depicting gods

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show or represent something in a picture or story
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词作定语，修饰 artworks，表示主动含义，意为“描绘神明的艺术品”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The mural depicts scenes from everyday life in the 19th century.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这幅壁画描绘了19世纪日常生活的情景。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to prevent something harmful from affecting you
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语作目的状语，原形 ward off 表示“以驱赶邪灵”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He wore a lucky charm to ward off evil spirits.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他戴了一个护身符以驱赶邪灵。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the main method used to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作主语，在句中说明年画的主要技术是木版印刷。
vocab_pack.example_en: The primary technique for making pottery in this region is hand-coiling.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个地区制作陶器的主要技术是手捏盘筑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The primary technique used in New Year painting is woodblock printing.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a printing technique using carved wooden blocks to transfer ink onto paper
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作表语，说明主语 technique 的具体内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: Woodblock printing was one of the earliest printing methods in human history.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 木版印刷是人类历史上最早的印刷方法之一。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The primary technique used in New Year painting is woodblock printing.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to include something as a necessary part or result
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 process 为单数第三人称，谓语用 involves，表示该过程包括用黑色墨水打印基本轮廓。
vocab_pack.example_en: The experiment involves mixing two chemicals carefully.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个实验涉及仔细混合两种化学物质。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The process involves printing the basic outlines of the design in black ink.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the simplest or most important lines that show the shape of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作宾语，复数形式，与形容词 basic 连用，表示“设计的基本轮廓”。
vocab_pack.example_en: First, draw the basic outline of the figure in pencil.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 首先，用铅笔画出人物的大致轮廓。
vocab_pack.from_passage: printing the basic outlines of the design

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cut a shape or pattern into a hard surface
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时的被动语态，由 has been + 过去分词 carved 构成，强调木版已经被雕刻以表示线条。
vocab_pack.example_en: The artisan has carved intricate patterns into the ivory.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 工匠在象牙上雕刻了精细的图案。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a woodblock that has been carved to represent the drawing's lines

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be a sign or symbol of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语作目的状语，修饰 carved，意为“为了表示画作的线条”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The colour red often represents good luck in Chinese culture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 红色在中国文化中常代表好运。
vocab_pack.from_passage: carved to represent the drawing's lines

vocab_pack.definition_en: the first or bottom layer of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作主语，在 once 引导的状语从句中，表示“一旦这个底层被印刷”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Apply a base layer of foundation before putting on makeup.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 上妆之前先涂一层粉底。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Once this base layer is printed

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be in line or agreement with something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形，副词 perfectly 修饰 align，with 引出对齐对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new policy must align with the company's long-term goals.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新政策必须与公司的长期目标保持一致。
vocab_pack.from_passage: must perfectly align with the black outlines

vocab_pack.definition_en: using hands rather than machines
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作方式状语，修饰 colored，表示“手工上色”。
vocab_pack.example_en: These delicate items are made entirely by hand.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些精致的物品全部是手工制作的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: may have to be colored by hand

vocab_pack.definition_en: the effect something has on the way it looks
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作宾语，与动词 lift 搭配，表示“提升画作的视觉冲击力”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bright colours of the poster create a strong visual impact.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 海报的明亮色彩产生了强烈的视觉冲击力。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a particular style or category of art, music, or literature
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作介词 in 的宾语，构成短语 in the genre，意为“在这一体裁中”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Science fiction is a popular genre among young readers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 科幻小说是年轻读者中流行的体裁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: One of the most famous styles in the genre

vocab_pack.definition_en: strong and clear in shape or colour; not shy or hesitant
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语，与 concise 并列修饰 lines，表示“粗犷而简洁的线条”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The artist used bold strokes to create a dramatic effect.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 艺术家用大胆的笔触创造了戏剧性的效果。

vocab_pack.definition_en: short and clear, with no unnecessary words
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语，与 bold 并列修饰 lines，表示“线条简洁明了”。
vocab_pack.example_en: A concise summary is often more effective than a long one.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 简洁的总结往往比冗长的更有效。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come from a particular place or start at a particular time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，与 flourished 并列作谓语，表示这一风格起源于开封并繁荣。
vocab_pack.example_en: This tradition originated in the Ming Dynasty.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个传统起源于明朝。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It originated and flourished in Kaifeng

vocab_pack.definition_en: to grow or develop successfully and strongly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，与 originated 并列作谓语，表示该风格在开封蓬勃发展。
vocab_pack.example_en: Trade flourished along the Silk Road.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 贸易在丝绸之路上繁荣发展。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It originated and flourished in Kaifeng

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be in a particular place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 Kaifeng，相当于 which was located，表示“位于距朱仙镇约20公里处”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum is located in the heart of the city.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆位于市中心。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be called or referred to as
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 art，相当于 which is known as，表示“在中文中被称为年画”。
vocab_pack.example_en: This fruit is known as a 'star fruit' because of its shape.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种水果因其形状而被称为‘杨桃’。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to add something attractive to something in order to make it more beautiful
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形，用于不定式结构 use these to decorate doors，表示“用这些来装饰门”。
vocab_pack.example_en: They often decorate their house with lights during the festival.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 节日期间他们常用灯饰装饰房子。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a traditional Chinese folk art form made for the Lunar New Year
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作介词 of 的宾语，是 folk art 的具体内容，表示“新年画”。
vocab_pack.example_en: New Year paintings are often pasted on doors during the Spring Festival.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 春节期间，年画常被贴在门上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The traditional Chinese folk art of New Year painting

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to both the moon and the sun, especially in calendars
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语，修饰 New Year，表示“阴阳历新年”，即农历新年。注意首字母大写。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Chinese calendar is a lunisolar calendar that combines lunar months and solar terms.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 中国农历是一种结合了阴历月和阳历节气的阴阳合历。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a supernatural being, such as a ghost or god
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词复数形式作介词 off 的宾语，与 bad 连用表示“恶灵”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Ancient people believed that spirits lived in the forest.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 古人认为森林里住着神灵。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a block of wood with a design carved into it used for printing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作宾语，表示制作木版画所用的工具。
vocab_pack.example_en: The printer carefully inked the woodblock before pressing it onto paper.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 印刷工在将木版压到纸上之前小心地上墨。
vocab_pack.from_passage: using a woodblock that has been carved

vocab_pack.definition_en: to increase or improve something, especially in quality or effect
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形，与 improve 并列用于不定式结构，表示“提升画作的视觉冲击力”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Good lighting can lift the mood of a room.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 良好的照明可以提升房间的氛围。
vocab_pack.from_passage: and lift the painting's visual impact

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start using a particular method or style
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词（动名词）作介词 after 的宾语，构成时间状语，表示“在采用这些特定的色块之后”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many schools have adopted a new teaching approach.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多学校采用了新的教学方法。
